variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are declared with LET. They map to memory cells (words).

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
// Typeless language
LET a = 42
LET b = 'A'
LET c = "Hello"
data_types.notes: BCPL is typeless. All data types are represented as a single uniform data type (a machine word).

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
LET sum = a + b
LET diff = a - b
LET isEq = a = b
LET ptrVal = !p
operators.notes: Provides arithmetic and bitwise operators. The '!' operator is used for indirection (pointer dereference).

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
TEST x > 0 THEN
  y := 1
OR
  y := -1
conditionals.notes: Uses TEST ... THEN ... OR for conditional branching. 'IF' exists but doesn't have an 'ELSE' equivalent.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Standard FOR loop iterating from a start to an end value.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Loops while a condition is true.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions use VALOF blocks and return values using RESULTIS. Short functions can use a single expression.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are allocated with VEC. The '!' operator is used for array indexing (like a pointer offset).

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Dictionaries/maps are absent and must be implemented manually.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.code: // Handled via return codes or non-local gotos.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: BCPL provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: BCPL supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: BCPL provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: BCPL converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: BCPL represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: BCPL formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: BCPL branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: BCPL defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: BCPL iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: BCPL organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: BCPL stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: BCPL groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: BCPL tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: BCPL organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
